title: Old tmux e2e uses default tmux server and fails 5/6 on restart then busy-turn
description: test/e2e/dsh-tui.js runs tmux on the default server (Jake's) and the 'Space stars... survive restart' then busy-turn tests flaked 5/6.
acceptance_criteria: E2E runs on a private tmux socket with -f /dev/null; restart/busy flows pass repeatedly (>=5 loops).

title: Two TUIs writing model-stars.json race / lose updates
description: Concurrent toggles from two dsh-TUI processes sharing ~/.dsh-tui: a scene's in-memory set goes stale and a toggle can resurrect/drop the other process's stars; tmp file name only pid-unique.
acceptance_criteria: Spec-defined merge policy (read-modify-write per toggle, re-read on open/toggle); test with two writers; red then fix if it fails.

title: toggleStar ignores a failed stars-file write
description: lib/store.js toggleStar returns the toggled set even when writeRefs fails, so the UI shows a star that was never persisted (lost on restart).
acceptance_criteria: When the stars file cannot be written, the scene shows the persisted state (no phantom star) and tells the user; red test then fix.

title: Step 9: Release procedure, CHANGELOG, release cut
description: RELEASING.md per new-dsh-plugin references/release.md (SemVer, alpha channel matching DSH, exact peer pins, CHANGELOG, annotated tag). Round 3: cut release if all suites green.
acceptance_criteria: RELEASING.md + CHANGELOG.md committed; round 3 tag vX.Y.Z-alpha.N pushed if green.

title: Step 8: Bugs red->green and mutation check
description: Red commit then fix commit per bug; plant deliberate mutants against new tests and record caught N/N.
acceptance_criteria: All bug beads closed with red sha and fix sha; mutants caught N/N recorded in TESTING.md.

title: Step 7: TESTING.md traceability table
description: Table property ID -> test file/name -> surface -> last result with seed, run count, DSH versions. No required test silently skips.
acceptance_criteria: Every SPEC property maps to >=1 test with a recorded result.

title: Step 6: dsh-TUI property tests in private tmux
description: Real dsh-TUI (nix-config patch stack) in a private tmux socket: fast-check generated key/command sequences on Launchpad and in chat; invariants after each step; seed replay.
acceptance_criteria: TUI property suite passes >=25 sequences/round (>=100 across >=3 seeds for release) with seeds logged.

title: Step 5: Web inertness property (Playwright, real dsh web)
description: No web surface: plugin loaded into a real dsh web profile must not break or alter the web client. Playwright with fast-check generated action sequences, invariants per step, FC_SEED/NUM_RUNS replay, screenshots on failure.
acceptance_criteria: Web inertness property passes >=25 sequences/round with seeds logged; compares plugin-loaded vs baseline.

title: Step 4: Vendor rig.mjs and mock-llm.mjs
description: Copy nix-config skills/new-dsh-plugin/scripts/{rig.mjs,mock-llm.mjs} into test/rig/ with source commit note; import by relative path only; private tmux socket started with -f /dev/null.
acceptance_criteria: test/rig/ present with SOURCE note; no import from ~/.agents; e2e uses private tmux socket.

title: Step 3: Nix flake: package, devShell, checks, e2e app
description: flake.nix with packages.default (version from package.json), devShells.default (node, tmux, nix chromium for playwright, beads, pinned dsh 0.2.1-alpha.2 + dsh-TUI 0.14.0 with nix-config patch stack), checks running fast suites, apps.e2e. Inputs pinned by rev; nix-dsh rev f0ca0d74 as in nix-config.
acceptance_criteria: nix flake check passes; nix run .#e2e runs real-client suites; flake.lock committed.

title: Step 2: SPEC.md with stable property IDs
description: Collect every property from README/TESTING.md/code comments/tests into SPEC.md with IDs P-xx, observable oracle and surfaces. Record web 'surface not applicable' rationale.
acceptance_criteria: SPEC.md committed; each property has ID, oracle, surface(s); web N/A rationale present.

title: Step 1: Source reconcile with nix-config vendored copy
description: Compare repo main with ~/nix-config/pkgs/dsh-model-selector (vendored at 1a15abf) and commit a sync if they differ.
acceptance_criteria: Byte comparison of index.js, lib/, package.json, README.md, LICENSE recorded; main equals deployed code.
close_reason: Verified 2026-10-11: cmp index.js package.json README.md LICENSE + diff -r lib between repo main 1a15abf and ~/nix-config/pkgs/dsh-model-selector (nix-config 6a7e613) -> all identical; pkgs/dsh-model-selector.nix vendors at 1a15abf. No sync commit needed.

title: Spec-driven real-client test system, Nix env and release procedure
description: Give dsh-model-selector a complete spec-driven, real-client test system and Nix environment, fix the bugs it exposes, and add a SemVer release procedure. Ralph loop of 3 rounds (state in beads + RALPH.md).
acceptance_criteria: All step beads closed with evidence; every SPEC property mapped to a passing test in TESTING.md; release cut in round 3 if every required suite is green.
